name: myops-mobile
description: MyOps as a self-contained Android and iOS app: your AI team runs on the phone with your own AI login or key.

scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap add android && node patch-native.mjs android && npm run assets -- --android && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && node patch-native.mjs ios && npm run assets -- --ios && npx cap sync ios
